vendor.name: International Association of Computer Investigative Specialists

logistics.format: Online or in-person 36-hour course over 5 consecutive days followed by certification examination on advanced Windows artefacts (registry, USN, Volume Shadow Copies, modern Windows internals); IACIS-administered

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The CFCE prerequisite and advanced Windows-artifact practical work establish a focused forensic specialization; training gates and limited independent recognition constrain portability beyond that investigative niche.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Advanced Windows artifacts and internals built on CFCE form a focused forensic specialization. The recorded hands-on component and law-enforcement recognition are strong signals, while training access and limited outside recognition constrain portability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded Windows-internals and artifact depth builds explicitly on CFCE and includes practical assessment. That advanced forensic branch fits specialty, with limited wider recognition constraining broader claims.
